### 2️⃣ Animation options for the voice‑mode UI (R2)

| Theme | Description | Where to place |
|-------|-------------|----------------|
| **Mic Pulse** | A pulsing mic icon that grows/shrinks with audio amplitude. | Top center of screen. |
| **Waveform** | Real‑time audio waveform visualizer. | Below the mic icon, as a horizontal bar. |
| **Rewind‑Seek** | A faint, looping rewind symbol appearing after a phrase ends, indicating “waiting for response”. | Center of the mic button. |
| **Chat Bubble Fade** | Bubbles fade in/out with a gentle spring as text appears. | Bottom of screen, standard chat layout. |
| **Microphone Blink** | The mic icon blinks when speaking out loud. | Top right corner. |
| **Listening Spinner** | A subtle rotating spinner showing “listening” state. | Middle of screen during input capture. |
| **Voice Wave Emitter** | Little bubbles emit from the mic when the user speaks, dissolving into the reply bubble. | Secondary effect after a segment. |

*All animations use Android Jetpack Compose (`animateFloatAsState`, `AnimatedVisibility`, `Modifier.scale`, etc.) or SwiftUI equivalents.*

---

### 3️⃣ Quick implementation snippet (Android Compose)

```kotlin
@Composable
fun VoiceScreen(viewModel: VoiceViewModel) {
    val micLevel by viewModel.micLevel.collectAsState()
    val isListening by viewModel.isListening.collectAsState()

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        // Mic Pulse
        Icon(
            painter = painterResource(R.drawable.ic_mic),
            contentDescription = "Microphone",
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(80.dp)
                .graphicsLayer { scaleX = micLevel; scaleY = micLevel }
                .clickable { viewModel.toggleListening() }
        )

        // Waveform
        if (isListening) Spectrogram(viewModel.wavData)

        // Reply bubble
        LazyColumn(Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter)) {
            items(viewModel.replies) { reply ->
                TextBubble(text = reply)
            }
        }
    }
}
```
